slots.title: Cardano holders are being asked to bet $5 million on copper hitting a new record
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Toto Finance wants 22 million ADA from Cardano’s treasury to buy tokenized copper, and the metal would have to trade well above its all-time high for holders to get their money back.

slots.title: Bitcoin, gold trim early losses as yen gives up gains. Oil stays near $100
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin and gold pared early losses as the yen gave up gains and Asian stocks rebounded, though oil near $100 keeps inflation risks in focus.

slots.title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

slots.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.

slots.title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.
